subject: Future Tech
title: Neuralink's Bold Bet
description: A quick win: understand Neuralink's Bold Bet.

hook.text: Elon Musk founded Neuralink in 2016 with a grand vision: merge human brains with artificial intelligence.

buildup.text: Neuralink designed flexible threads, a surgical robot, and a coin-sized implant called the N1 chip.

discovery.text: In January 2024, the first human patient received a Neuralink implant and controlled a computer cursor within weeks.

twist.text: Some threads retracted after surgery, reducing the number of working electrodes. The company adapted its approach.

climax.text: Neuralink's real contribution may be making BCIs mainstream. Its publicity brought billions in global attention.

punchline.text: Neuralink made brain implants a dinner table topic.

quiz.question: What is Neuralink's implant chip called?
